end.parentNote: Asha practised examples of nature-protecting traditions with Dev using cause-and-effect explanations. Dev explained roots holding soil, sacred groves supporting animals, and neem leaves keeping insects away from grain. The neem-and-grain explanation was clarified during the lesson. At home, ask Dev to make a three-column chart: tradition, what people do, and how it helps nature.
